meaning: In each class, the listed transfer rules make every line's final value >= 0 for EVERY even n (n >= 4) and every arrangement of pseudolines with only simple and triple points in the class: hence sum_L final >= 0, 3*Lambda - n >= waste >= 0, Lambda >= n/3 (T <= 54 at n=14, T <= 72 at n=16, T <= 94 at n=18 for these classes). 'DP min' is min over all paths and cycles of the enriched line automaton of D*(2*final+2); the certificate requires >= 2D.

assumed_facts.always: T20 facts F1-F8, enriched apex flags (validated: 127,673 arrangements / 2.14M lines, 0 failures), F4' (two consecutive simple vertices never cap the same side; proof in INTERIM.md)
assumed_facts.C2: additionally K1* (--k1) and K2 (--k2), proved by the lead / T23
